# Hatch & Forge

> Premier construction management and real estate investment partner in Washington, DC. We manage turnkey residential renovations, ground-up new construction, design pre-construction feasibility, and capital partnerships for active real estate investors.

## Main Pages & Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services): Comprehensive overview of all 5 service lines with pricing and deliverables.
- [Fix-and-Flip Project Management](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services/fix-and-flip): End-to-end renovation management for residential real estate investors (10% to 15% PM fee).
- [New Construction Management](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services/new-construction): Turnkey ground-up construction, infill development, and teardown-rebuilds in Washington, DC.
- [Design & Pre-Construction](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services/design-pre-construction): Feasibility analysis, architectural space planning, permit coordination, and ARV-optimized finish selections.
- [Proprietary Investment & Co-Investment](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services/proprietary-investment): Joint ventures, equity co-investments, and self-managed construction partnerships.
- [Portfolio Management Services](https://www.hatchandforge.com/services/portfolio-management): Enterprise construction oversight and procurement for multi-property real estate funds.
